description: כמה כסף יש בבנק, וכמה בסך הכול עם קופת המזומן. calculatedBalance is the bank opening balance plus payments received into the bank and cash deposited into the bank, minus expenses paid from the bank, bank refunds to residents and cash withdrawn from the bank, since the opening balance date. CASH payments placed in the cash box and the cash part of expenses are counted in the cash box instead, and offset settled parts of expenses are not subtracted. paymentsReceived never counts offsets; offsetCredits reports them separately and refundsPaid is the bank refund total (CASH refunds come out of the cash box). totalFunds is calculatedBalance plus the cash box balance, or null when no bank opening balance is set. Also returns the last bank-synced balance when an imported transaction includes a balance field; it is labeled separately and never added to the other figures.

buildingId.description: Building UUID. Either buildingId or buildingName is required.

buildingName.description: Building name, or an unambiguous substring of it, matched case-insensitively. Used when buildingId is omitted.
